newsitem.title: JAPAN: VW launches new Audi A3 in Japan.
newsitem.headline: VW launches new Audi A3 in Japan.

text.p: Volkswagen AG's Japanese unit on Monday launched the luxury Audi A3 compact car in Japan.
"We are setting a sales target of 2,800 Audi A3 models in 1997 with a price of 2.85 million yen in Tokyo," Volkswagen Group Japan KK vice-president Robert Janson told reporters.
It is the first time Audi has sold a car for less than three million yen in Japan, Janson said.
The firm aims to boost its total 1997 sales of Audis in Japan by 50 percent from last year to 15,000 cars, he said.
The Audi A3 three-door hatchback is powered by an 1800 cc twin-cam engine and is equipped with safety devices such as dual air bags and an anti-lock brake system.
The firm is likely to increase its sales outlets by 20 to about 250 by the end of 1997, Janson said, and will launch another new Audi model and two Volkswagen cars this year.
